value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: clause 2 ("Open the door.") is redundant because door_open is already implied by the hard Existence(target_picked_up) and hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up). Remove the hard Existence(door_open) to avoid unnecessary duplication.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The first clause "Avoid dropping the key while the door is still closed." is encoded as a soft Absence(key_lost), which forbids key_lost at all times. The task only requires that key_lost not happen while the door is closed. Replace this clause with a soft Precedence(door_open, key_lost) clause, so that key_lost is prohibited only before door_open. Also, the clause "Open the door." (hard Existence(door_open)) is redundant, because hard Existence(target_picked_up) together with Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) already forces door_open to occur. Remove the redundant Existence(door_open) clause.
